rule.title: AD Groups Or Users Enumeration Using PowerShell - PoshModule
rule.author: frack113

es.summary: El registro de módulos de PowerShell (evento 4103) muestra Get-ADPrincipalGroupMembership o Get-ADUser con abreviaturas -f/-pr y DoesNotRequirePreAuth. Puede indicar que alguien está enumerando grupos y usuarios de Active Directory.
es.what_it_detects: Busca en los campos Payload o ContextInfo del log ps_module dos patrones. El primero es la llamada a Get-ADPrincipalGroupMembership. El segundo es Get-ADUser con los parámetros abreviados '-f ' y '-pr ' junto con la propiedad DoesNotRequirePreAuth.
es.why_it_matters: Corresponde a Permission Groups Discovery (T1069). Saber a qué grupos pertenece cada usuario permite ubicar cuentas privilegiadas. Consultar DoesNotRequirePreAuth revela cuentas sin preautenticación Kerberos, que suelen ser el objetivo de AS-REP roasting.
triage_steps: Lea Payload y ContextInfo completos: el cmdlet, los parámetros, Host Application, la ruta del script y el usuario que lo ejecutó.
Identifique al usuario y al host. Confirme si la cuenta pertenece a un administrador de AD o a una cuenta de servicio de automatización conocida.
Revise el proceso padre de powershell.exe en Sysmon o EDR. Considere sospechosos un padre como Office, wscript, mshta o un servicio inusual.
Busque en el mismo host, en una ventana de +/- 15 minutos, otras consultas a AD (Get-ADGroupMember, Get-ADComputer, net group), descargas o Invoke-Expression.
Si se consultó DoesNotRequirePreAuth, revise en los controladores de dominio si hubo eventos 4768 con tipo de preautenticación 0 hacia esas cuentas.
Compare con alertas previas del mismo usuario y host, y averigüe si existe un script o una tarea programada que haga esta consulta con frecuencia.
false_positives: Scripts de administradores que auditan membresías de grupos o la configuración de cuentas en AD.
Auditorías de seguridad o pentests autorizados que revisan cuentas sin preautenticación Kerberos.
Herramientas internas de gestión de identidades o de reportes que usan el módulo ActiveDirectory.
response_steps: Confirme con el dueño de la cuenta o con el equipo de AD si la actividad era esperada y está documentada.
Si no está autorizada, aísle el endpoint mediante el EDR y conserve los logs de PowerShell y el historial de la sesión.
Restablezca las credenciales del usuario implicado y revise sus inicios de sesión recientes en el dominio.
Habilite la preautenticación Kerberos en las cuentas que la tengan deshabilitada y rote sus contraseñas, en especial si son privilegiadas.
Si la actividad es legítima, documente el script, el host y la cuenta para afinar la regla.
es.severity_rationale: El nivel bajo es adecuado porque estas consultas son habituales en la administración de AD y solo tienen relevancia cuando se suman a otros indicios.

en.summary: PowerShell module logging (event 4103) recorded Get-ADPrincipalGroupMembership, or Get-ADUser with the abbreviated -f/-pr parameters and DoesNotRequirePreAuth. This may mean someone is enumerating Active Directory groups or users.
en.what_it_detects: It looks for two patterns in the Payload or ContextInfo fields of ps_module logs. The first is a call to Get-ADPrincipalGroupMembership. The second is Get-ADUser with the abbreviated '-f ' and '-pr ' parameters plus the DoesNotRequirePreAuth property.
en.why_it_matters: This maps to Permission Groups Discovery (T1069). Group membership data shows which accounts are privileged. Querying DoesNotRequirePreAuth finds accounts without Kerberos pre-authentication, which are the usual targets of AS-REP roasting.
triage_steps: Read the full Payload and ContextInfo: the cmdlet, its parameters, Host Application, the script path and the user who ran it.
Identify the user and host. Check whether the account belongs to an AD administrator or a known automation service account.
Check the parent process of powershell.exe in Sysmon or EDR. Treat Office, wscript, mshta or an unusual service as a suspicious parent.
On the same host within +/- 15 minutes, look for other AD queries (Get-ADGroupMember, Get-ADComputer, net group), downloads or Invoke-Expression.
If DoesNotRequirePreAuth was queried, check the domain controllers for event 4768 with pre-authentication type 0 against those accounts.
Compare with earlier alerts for the same user and host, and find out whether a script or scheduled task runs this query regularly.
false_positives: Administrator scripts that audit group membership or account settings in AD.
Authorized security audits or pentests that check for accounts without Kerberos pre-authentication.
Internal identity-management or reporting tools that use the ActiveDirectory module.
response_steps: Confirm with the account owner or the AD team whether the activity was expected and documented.
If it was not authorized, isolate the endpoint through EDR and preserve the PowerShell logs and session history.
Reset the credentials of the user involved and review that user's recent domain logons.
Enable Kerberos pre-authentication on accounts where it is disabled and rotate their passwords, especially privileged ones.
If the activity is legitimate, document the script, host and account so the rule can be tuned.
en.severity_rationale: Low fits because these queries are common in AD administration and only matter when they appear alongside other suspicious activity.

positive.description: Group membership enumeration of a domain user with Get-ADPrincipalGroupMembership

event.ContextInfo: Severity = Informational Host Name = ConsoleHost Host Application = powershell.exe -nop Get-ADPrincipalGroupMembership -Identity mlopez Command Name = Get-ADPrincipalGroupMembership Command Type = Cmdlet User = ANDES\jperez

positive.description: Search for accounts without Kerberos pre-authentication using abbreviated Get-ADUser parameters

event.ContextInfo: Severity = Informational Host Name = ConsoleHost Host Application = powershell.exe get-aduser -f * -pr DoesNotRequirePreAuth Command Name = Get-ADUser Command Type = Cmdlet User = ANDES\jperez
event.Payload: CommandInvocation(Get-ADUser): "Get-ADUser" ParameterBinding(Get-ADUser): name="Filter"; value="*" ParameterBinding(Get-ADUser): name="Properties"; value="DoesNotRequirePreAuth"

negative.description: Get-ADUser with full parameter names (-Filter, -Properties), so the '-f ' and '-pr ' substrings are absent

event.ContextInfo: Severity = Informational Host Name = ConsoleHost Host Application = powershell.exe Get-ADUser -Filter * -Properties DoesNotRequirePreAuth Command Name = Get-ADUser Command Type = Cmdlet User = ANDES\adm_rgarcia

negative.description: Routine single-user lookup with Get-ADUser, no pre-auth property and no group membership cmdlet

event.ContextInfo: Severity = Informational Host Name = ConsoleHost Host Application = powershell.exe Get-ADUser -Identity mlopez Command Name = Get-ADUser Command Type = Cmdlet User = ANDES\adm_rgarcia
